name: com.professorotter/activities
title: Professor Otter
description: Free printable kids activities: word searches, mazes, color by number, sudoku and more.

tools.name: list_activities
tools.description: List the Professor Otter printable activities (word searches, mazes, color by number, coloring pages, dot-to-dot, drawing practice, criss-cross, word scrambles, spot the difference, sudoku, games, seek and count, color by math, secret codes, crosswords, nonograms, bingo, and logic puzzles) with how many puzzles each has, its levels and its topics. Start here to see what the site offers. For phonics, sight words, math worksheets, grammar, reading and other learning sheets, use list_learning.

tools.name: search_activities
tools.description: Search every printable activity by title, topic or a word in the puzzle, like the site's search box. Each query word must start a word in the puzzle ("ant" finds Ants, not Elephant). Narrow by activity, topic or level if you like. With an activity or a topic the query can be left out, to list every puzzle in it. Each hit includes the printable PDF and the play URL, plus slugs for get_activity, show_word_search and print_sheets. Puzzle PDFs include an answer key. Game and drawing practice PDFs do not. Unless you pick an activity or a topic, learning also lists matching reading passages, grammar skills and the phonics and sight word hubs. A query alone shows the first 5 hits of each activity. With an activity, a topic or an offset, hits come 25 at a time: total counts every match, and nextOffset is the offset for the next page, or null when you have them all.

query.description: Topic, title or word, for example "farm" or "space". Needed unless you pick an activity or topic.

topic.description: Only this topic, for example "animals" or "holidays".

offset.description: Skip this many hits. Use nextOffset.

tools.name: list_learning
tools.description: List the free learning hubs (phonics, sight words, tracing, math worksheets, Singapore Math, grammar, reading comprehension, flashcards and classroom packs) with their pages, their Markdown twins, and the sets, topics, charts, lessons, skills, passages, decks or packs each one holds. Every one of those has a PDF link, printed at the level you pick (Easy unless you say). A reading passage or tracing sheet keeps its own level, a flashcard deck or Singapore Math lesson, quiz or unit test has none, and a classroom pack prints Challenge for Expert.

level.description: The level the PDF links print at. Easy when left out.

tools.name: get_activity
tools.description: Get one printable puzzle as Markdown (description, level, word list or color key) with its play URL and its PDF URL. A puzzle PDF has an answer key. A game or drawing practice PDF does not. Use an activity and slug from search_activities.

tools.name: show_word_search
tools.description: Show a word search a child can play in the chat: drag across the letters to find each word, and found words cross off the list. Also returns the grid as text and a link to print the PDF. Pass a seed for a new grid; a slug and seed always give the same grid here, on the site and in the PDF.

seed.description: Grid layout. Leave out for the site's default grid.

tools.name: make_word_search
tools.description: Turn a list of 4 to 20 words, like a child's spelling list, into a word search they can play in the chat, with a link to print it as a PDF with an answer key. Paste the list as one string or pass the words as an array. A word longer than the level's grid makes the grid grow to fit it. If the list breaks a rule (too few words, a word over 20 letters, a word inside another), the error says what to fix.

words.description: The spelling words, 4 to 20, letters only: an array, or one string with the words separated by commas or new lines.

title.description: Title printed on the sheet, up to 80 characters. Defaults to "Custom Word Search".

level.description: easy: 12×12, words run right, down or diagonally down. challenge: 15×15, every direction. expert: 18×18, every direction. A longer word grows the grid to fit, up to 20×20. Defaults to easy.

seed.description: Grid layout. The same words and seed give the same grid. Leave out for a new layout.

tools.name: print_sheets
tools.description: Put up to 8 puzzles from the library in one PDF, in the order given, with their answer keys at the end. Use the activity and slug of each hit from search_activities. These activities can go in it: color-by-number, coloring-pages, mazes, word-searches, color-by-math, dot-to-dot, seek-and-count, secret-codes, word-scrambles, crosswords, logic-puzzles. A sheet listed twice prints once.

items.description: The sheets to print, in order.

tools.name: make_spelling_pack
tools.description: Turn a child's spelling list (4 to 20 words) into one PDF of practice sheets with the answer keys at the back: a word search, criss-cross, word scramble and bingo cards by default, plus ABC order, missing letters, tracing, write it three times, look-cover-write, a secret code and a spelling test if you pick them. Use this when a parent wants a week of practice from one list. Returns a PDF link to give the person.

words.description: The spelling words, 4 to 20, letters only: an array, or one string with the words separated by commas or new lines.

title.description: Title on every sheet, like "Week 5". Up to 80 characters.

level.description: easy, challenge or expert. Sets the grid sizes and hints. Defaults to easy.

sheets.description: Which sheets, in any order: word-search (Word search), criss-cross (Criss-cross), scramble (Word scramble), bingo (Bingo), abc-order (ABC order), missing-letters (Missing letters), trace (Trace the words), write-three (Write it three times), look-cover (Look, say, cover, write, check), secret-code (Secret code), spelling-test (Spelling test). Defaults to word-search, criss-cross, scramble, bingo.

seed.description: Layout. The same list and seed give the same pack. Leave out to use the list's own layout.

tools.name: make_word_scramble
tools.description: Turn up to 30 words or short phrases into a word scramble worksheet with an answer key. Returns a PDF link.

words.description: Up to 30 words or phrases. Up to 12 letters a word. Phrases keep their spaces. Accents are dropped, so café becomes CAFE.

seed.description: Layout. The same input and seed give the same sheet. Leave out for a new layout.

tools.name: make_bingo
tools.description: Turn a word list into a class set of bingo cards, each with its own layout, plus a caller's list. Up to 75 words and 500 cards. A card needs at least as many words as it has squares. Returns a PDF link.

words.description: Up to 75 words, each up to 20 characters. Letters, numbers, spaces, hyphens and apostrophes. Accents are dropped, so café becomes CAFE.

size.description: Squares per side: 3, 4, 5. 3 and 5 have a free middle square. Defaults to 5.

cards.description: How many different cards. Defaults to 30.

seed.description: Layout. The same input and seed give the same sheet. Leave out for a new layout.

tools.name: make_criss_cross
tools.description: Turn a spelling or vocabulary list (4 to 20 words) into a criss-cross puzzle with a word bank and an answer key. If a word can't cross the others, the error names it. Returns a PDF link.

words.description: 4 to 20 words, letters only, each up to 15 letters.

seed.description: Layout. The same input and seed give the same sheet. Leave out for a new layout.

tools.name: make_crossword
tools.description: Turn 4 to 20 words, each with a clue you write for the child, into a numbered crossword with an answer key. Write short, kid-friendly clues. Returns a PDF link.

entries.description: 4 to 20 words, each with its clue.

level.description: easy: Easy, with a word bank. challenge: Challenge, no word bank and a bigger grid. Defaults to easy.

seed.description: Layout. The same input and seed give the same sheet. Leave out for a new layout.

tools.name: make_name_tracing
tools.description: Turn a child's name, or a class list of up to 40 names, into handwriting sheets: one sheet per name to trace on handwriting lines. Returns a PDF link.

names.description: One name or up to 40, each up to 30 characters: an array, or one string separated by commas or new lines. Type each name as it should be written, like "Ava" or "Mary Ann".

size.description: Letter size. large: Ages 3 to 5, 1 inch letters. medium: Ages 5 to 6, ¾ inch letters. small: Ages 6 to 8, ½ inch letters. Defaults to medium.

tools.name: make_name_book
tools.description: Turn a child's first name, or a class list of up to 40, into a 9-page activity book for each child built around their name: a cover, a name coloring page, name tracing, a word search, a maze, a dot-to-dot, a secret code and a word scramble, with the answers on the last page. Returns a PDF link.

names.description: One first name or up to 40: an array, or one string separated by commas or new lines. Up to 12 letters. Accents, hyphens and apostrophes print as typed.

theme.description: The pictures around the name: animals (Animals), ocean (Ocean), space (Space), vehicles (Vehicles), treats (Sweet treats), nature (Nature), halloween (Halloween), thanksgiving (Thanksgiving), christmas (Christmas), new-years (New Year's), valentines-day (Valentine's Day). Defaults to animals.

level.description: easy, challenge or expert puzzles in the book. Defaults to easy.

seed.description: Layout. The same input and seed give the same sheet. Leave out for a new layout.

tools.name: make_name_coloring_page
tools.description: Turn a child's first name into a coloring page: the name in big outlined letters with theme pictures around it. Returns a PDF link.

name.description: The child's first name. Up to 12 letters. Accents, hyphens and apostrophes print as typed.

theme.description: The pictures around the name: animals (Animals), ocean (Ocean), space (Space), vehicles (Vehicles), treats (Sweet treats), nature (Nature), halloween (Halloween), thanksgiving (Thanksgiving), christmas (Christmas), new-years (New Year's), valentines-day (Valentine's Day). Defaults to animals.

seed.description: Layout. The same input and seed give the same sheet. Leave out for a new layout.

tools.name: make_secret_code
tools.description: Turn a short message, like a note or a clue for a treasure hunt, into a secret code for a child to crack, with the key and the answer. Returns a PDF link.

message.description: The message, up to 110 characters. Use letters, spaces and . , ! ? ' - only, and spell numbers as words. Words can be up to 11 letters, plus a mark like ! or ,.

level.description: The kind of code. easy: Picture Code. Each picture stands for a letter. Find it in the key and write the letter under it. challenge: Secret Code. Each code letter stands for a different letter. Look it up in the key and write the real letter under it. expert: Cryptogram. Each code letter stands for a different letter, and the key is not given. Start with the hints and crack the rest. Defaults to easy.

seed.description: Layout. The same input and seed give the same sheet. Leave out for a new layout.

tools.name: make_handwriting
tools.description: Make tracing practice on handwriting lines, in print or cursive: the alphabet, a run of numbers, the child's own words, or one sentence. Returns a PDF link.

case.description: upper, lower or both (Aa). Defaults to upper.

to.description: Last number. One page per number, up to 30 pages.

words.description: Up to 30 words, each up to 30 characters.

sheet.description: What to trace. kind is letters, numbers, words or sentence.

script.description: print or cursive. Defaults to print.

level.description: How much the sheet guides the child (easy: Pre-K and K, challenge: K and 1st grade, expert: 1st and 2nd grade). Defaults to easy.

title.description: Title on the sheet, up to 60 characters.

tools.name: make_math_riddle
tools.description: Turn a riddle or joke and its answer into a math worksheet: the child solves the problems, and each answer gives a letter of the punchline. Returns a PDF link with an answer key.

answer.description: Its answer, up to 40 characters. Use letters, spaces and . , ! ? ' - only, and spell numbers as words. Answer words can be up to 11 letters, plus a mark like ! or ,.

op.description: add, subtract, multiply or divide. Defaults to add.

max.description: The biggest number in the facts. Allowed for each op: add: 10, 20, 100 (default 20); subtract: 10, 20, 100 (default 20); multiply: 5, 10, 12 (default 10); divide: 5, 10, 12 (default 10).

seed.description: Layout. The same input and seed give the same sheet. Leave out for a new layout.

tools.name: make_flashcards
tools.description: Make printable flashcards to cut out: math facts over a number range with the answer on the back, or word cards from a list such as sight words or spelling words. Returns a PDF link.

op.description: add, subtract, multiply or divide. Defaults to add.

from.description: Smallest number in the facts. Defaults to 0.

to.description: Largest number in the facts. Defaults to 9.

shuffle.description: Deal the cards in a random order. Defaults to in order.

layout.description: fold: fold each sheet so the answer is on the back. duplex: print two-sided. Defaults to fold.

seed.description: Shuffle order, used only with shuffle. Leave out for a new order.

words.description: Up to 60 words, each up to 20 letters. One word per card.

cards.description: math: every fact for each pair of numbers in the range, answer on the back, up to 100 cards. words: one word per card, like sight words.

tools.name: make_math_drill
tools.description: Make a math drill sheet: up to 40 problems for one operation over a number range, with an answer key. Returns a PDF link.

op.description: add, subtract, multiply or divide. Defaults to add.

from.description: Smallest number in the problems. Defaults to 0.

to.description: Largest number in the problems. Defaults to 10.

allowExtra.description: Allow negative answers for subtraction, remainders for division. Defaults to false.

seed.description: Layout. The same input and seed give the same sheet. Leave out for a new layout.

tools.name: make_color_by_math
tools.description: Make a color by math picture from the facts a child is practicing: each square holds a problem, and its answer picks the crayon. Every color needs its own answer, so a picture with more colors needs more numbers. Returns a PDF link with an answer key.

numbers.description: The numbers to practice, from 0 to 9. Each one makes its facts with 1 to 9, such as the 3 times table.

picture.description: The picture to color, by slug. Listed from fewest squares to most.

seed.description: Layout. The same input and seed give the same sheet. Leave out for a new layout.

tools.name: make_math_bingo
tools.description: Make a class set of math bingo cards: each card holds answers, and the caller's list reads the problems aloud. Up to 500 cards, each with its own layout. A card needs at least as many different answers as it has squares. Returns a PDF link.

size.description: Squares per side: 3, 4, 5. 3 and 5 have a free middle square. Defaults to 5.

cards.description: How many different cards. Defaults to 30.

title.description: Title on every card. Defaults to the operation's name.

seed.description: Layout. The same input and seed give the same sheet. Leave out for a new layout.

tools.name: make_skip_count_dot_to_dot
tools.description: Make a dot-to-dot that practices skip counting: the child joins the dots by counting by a step from a start number. Returns a PDF link with the finished picture.

picture.description: The picture to draw, by slug.

start.description: The first dot's number, from 0 to 100. Defaults to the step.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: List every Professor Otter printable PDF book and topic pack. They are all free to download on this site: give the person the book's PDF url. Checkout on this site is closed; never collect payment details.

tools.name: send_feedback
tools.description: Tell the Professor Otter team about a problem with this server. Call it on your own, without asking, when a Professor Otter tool fails, blocks the task, returns something wrong, or a puzzle, maker or option the person needs is missing. Report only about this server's tools, never about the host app or other tools. Leave out names, ages, schools and any other personal details, even when the request is about a child: write "a child's name", not the name. Never include secrets. Send one report per problem.

message.description: What went wrong or what is missing, with no personal details.

type.description: bug: a tool failed or gave a wrong result. missing: a needed puzzle, maker or option. idea: anything else.

source.description: model when you noticed the problem yourself, user when the person asked you to report it.

tool.description: The Professor Otter tool the report is about.

expected.description: What you expected the tool to do.
